crossRefs.note: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.

A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.

translations.web: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
translations.bsb: A man’s steps are from the LORD, so how can anyone understand his own way?
translations.kjv: Man's goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
translations.asv: A man's goings are of Jehovah; How then can man understand his way?
